title: Raw Materials Supply Contract (Conflicting Liability Clauses)
description: Chemical supply agreement with deliberately conflicting liability clauses between Section 5 and Section 9.

payment_terms.quote: Payment shall be completed under Net 60 days from bill of lading issuance.

price_adjustment.quote: Commodity raw material prices are subject to renegotiation every six months based on feedstocks.

contract_term.quote: The contract duration of 36 months begins May 1, 2024.

auto_renewal.quote: The contract shall not automatically renew and terminates upon expiration.

termination_notice.quote: Either party may cancel with written notice of at least 90 days.

liability_cap.quote: Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary in Section 3.1, Seller liability is unlimited and uncapped liability applies for breach of delivery or product recalls.

governing_law.quote: This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Texas.

volume_commitment.raw: 250 metric tons of material per calendar month
volume_commitment.normalized: 250 metric tons of material per calendar month
volume_commitment.quote: Purchaser commits to purchase at least 250 metric tons of material per calendar month.
